spans.s: भैरव (I) a. (f. वी) 1. Relating to Bhairava; 2. terrible, terrific, horrible.
भैरव (II) m. A form of Śiva.
भैरव (I) a. (f. वी) 1. Relating to Bhairava; 2. terrible, terrific, horrible.
भैरवी f. 1. A form of Durgā; 2. name of a rāgiṇī; 3. a young girl personating Durgā at the festival of that goddess.
भैरव-ईश m. an epithet of Viṣṇu.
भैरव-यातना f. torments inflicted by Bhairava of Benares on those, who die there, to make their spirits fit for absorption into the supreme soul.
